visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Solid earthy backgrounds with subtle borders to maintain a premium B2B organic look. Avoid cold glassmorphism. NEVER use transparent backgrounds on headers that overlap content.
visual_enhancers.decorations: Use organic grain textures and large typography for high-end feel.

grids: Use 12-column bento layouts for collection features. Tight gaps for product catalogue to optimize for dense information like Amazon.
layouts: Mobile-first responsive grids. Generous padding (`p-8`, `p-12`) in marketing sections, tighter padding in product tables. The header must have `fixed z-50` and the content should have `pt-[header-height]`.
motion: Subtle hover states on cards, staggered fade-ins for product lists.
accessibility: High contrast text over imagery. All interactable elements must have aria-labels.
media: Images should have `object-cover`. Limit max-height on mobile to 80vh for banners.
3d_libraries: Not strictly required for this B2B catalog, rely on high-quality 2D imagery instead.
component_name: shadcn/ui primitives to be used for complex components (Dialog, Select). Standard HTML/Tailwind for cards and headers.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a locked/sticky header (Navbar) at the top without the 'minimum order' line.
Use the specific images provided in image_urls for the Hero section and 5 specific category cards.
Maintain the earthy luxury theme with high-contrast text and solid green/tan accents.
Include a WhatsApp ordering flow integration with prefilled messages.
Share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not apply generic centered layouts; prioritize natural reading flow.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not use universal transitions (e.g., transition: all).
Create depth through layered design elements and subtle shadows.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
NEVER use placeholder images; rely strictly on the provided image_urls.
